description: Verify a Delta Signal audio signature at an https WAV URL: returns which hidden layers are present (found_layers) and whether the audio matches an expected message (matches: true/false, or null if no expected_message given). Cheaper than full decode — use it when you only need to confirm presence or identity.

expected_message.description: Message you expect to find; omit to discover what is present

seed.description: Watermark key used when the signature was rendered

url.description: https URL of a WAV file

name: verify_signature
